# netactuate_platform_change_log_entry (Data Source)

Reads a Platform Change Log Entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_platform_change_log_entry" "example" {
  change_log_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `change_log_id` (Number) Platform change log entry ID.

### Read-Only

- `entry` (List of Object) Platform change log entry returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entry))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--entry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entry`

Read-Only:

- `change_log_id` (String)
- `entry_json` (String)
- `short_description` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `title` (String)
